hardFailures: a compound mutation partially commits while the UI reports whole-operation success
an outcome-unknown retry mints a different idempotency key
a local mock or sandbox artifact enters a production command path
a persisted configuration is described as effective before a real consumer applies it

cases.fault: concurrent stale limit writes plus a lost response
cases.oracle: one version wins and the real limiter consumes that version; no page default is reported as canonical

cases.fault: withdrawals straddle a concurrent threshold change
cases.oracle: D2 and B1 consume the same winning version and stale or unauthorized writes fail closed

cases.fault: publish, rollout and disable are submitted concurrently or out of order
cases.oracle: only legal CAS transitions survive and every accepted transition is audited once

cases.fault: an A1-only actor calls the permission-registration API directly
cases.oracle: the adjacent A6 authority cannot be inherited through the A1 surface or a stale session

cases.fault: initiator withdrawal races checker approval and rejection
cases.oracle: the operation reaches exactly one terminal state and only the initiator may withdraw a pending item

cases.fault: delivery commits, the receipt is lost, and the provider is retried
cases.oracle: delivery is deduplicated and a saved subscription is never presented as a delivered notification

cases.fault: two operators resolve the same signal from one snapshot
cases.oracle: one transition wins and the signal, audit record and readback agree

cases.fault: replace and recycle race after one side has written an outbox record
cases.oracle: device, trade-in and outbox state are atomic and the UniApp mock choreography cannot satisfy production evidence

cases.fault: withdrawal races approval and is replayed by another actor
cases.oracle: only the maker can withdraw once and a decided request cannot be reopened

cases.fault: local unlink succeeds while provider revocation times out and later contradicts the callback
cases.oracle: UNBOUND is not described as provider-token revocation until provider authority confirms it

cases.fault: production mode receives a locally minted token or a token replayed across users
cases.oracle: production requires provider verification and rejects every explicitly local or unverified token

cases.fault: the export URL is called without confirmation, reason or current authority
cases.oracle: no file is produced without the sensitive-export audit path and the result is masked

cases.fault: a withdrawal is created at the exemption boundary while policy changes
cases.oracle: the withdrawal state machine consumes one authoritative policy version; config persistence alone is insufficient

cases.fault: one VietQR receipt is posted twice while reconciliation runs
cases.oracle: the PC proxy reaches the real route and the receipt has one canonical reconciliation outcome

cases.fault: provider execution succeeds but the response is lost, followed by duplicate or out-of-order callbacks
cases.oracle: disabled or sandbox mode never sends funds; production ledger, order, callback and compensation remain idempotent

cases.fault: telemetry is stale, partial or unavailable during an operator action
cases.oracle: unavailable facts are not rendered as healthy, zero or no anomaly

cases.fault: pricing changes while dispatch consumes an old outbox event
cases.oracle: dispatch and App routing consume the same canonical version without falling back to static data

cases.fault: the App refresh fails after server capacity configuration changes
cases.oracle: the active lifecycle never silently falls back to MOCK-ONLY capacity or exemption constants

cases.fault: a quote expires or the source device is consumed between quote and submit
cases.oracle: order, discount and source-device lock commit once or all roll back

cases.fault: the UI key writes but the engine cooling key fails
cases.oracle: both keys commit atomically or the whole command fails and same-key retry converges

cases.fault: quota is lowered below usage while a new allocation races
cases.oracle: the authoritative tier and usage tables enforce the winning quota

cases.fault: two operators reclaim an in-use allocation
cases.oracle: inventory, assignment and audit remain atomic and one reclaim wins

cases.fault: approve and reject target different pending applications while benefit grant fails at item N
cases.oracle: the explicit application is resolved once and all benefits have atomic or itemized evidence

cases.fault: disqualification races leaderboard settlement
cases.oracle: the selected real member is excluded once; member zero or a fixed placeholder can never satisfy the action

cases.fault: SKU grant commits at the provider but its acknowledgement is lost
cases.oracle: retry grants at most once and PENDING_GRANT is not reported as granted

cases.fault: multi-layer pause fails on layer N or leaves multiple A2 tickets partly approved
cases.oracle: one atomic batch or an explicit authoritative per-layer result replaces whole-operation success

cases.fault: the CTA is double-clicked and then directly invoked without authority
cases.oracle: a real persisted and consumed rule changes once; toast-only completion is forbidden

cases.fault: period commits and residual fails, then the retry reverses failure order
cases.oracle: the compound configuration has one version and cannot expose a half-applied state

cases.fault: cron changes around leader election, restart and a due firing
cases.oracle: the scheduler consumes the canonical cron and fires the period exactly once

cases.fault: prize parameters change during leaderboard settlement
cases.oracle: the payout binds to one snapshot and each period is paid at most once

cases.fault: pool pause and settlement race with insufficient balance
cases.oracle: real ranking and settlement consume poolUsd, minUsd and paused as one coherent control set

cases.fault: pause and resume are submitted concurrently or resume targets an active event
cases.oracle: one legal transition wins and is audited once

cases.fault: an export job fails or its signed URL is reused by another actor
cases.oracle: a real masked CSV has a scoped receipt; a toast or reusable URL is not completion

cases.fault: source event N is missing, conflicting or duplicated after earlier candidates validate
cases.oracle: no prefix commission, ledger or operation survives; failed idempotency cannot replay success and source uniqueness blocks overlap

cases.fault: tier restore races the J1 product kill switch
cases.oracle: only the selected tier is restored and the product-level safety state remains authoritative

cases.fault: edit, disable, archive and delete race on a task with active participation
cases.oracle: one versioned lifecycle transition wins and App visibility agrees

cases.fault: cadence changes and channel disable race a scheduler restart
cases.oracle: the three v3 channels consume server cadence and stop without duplicate delivery

cases.fault: an enabled dynamic channel has no adapter or authoritative event source
cases.oracle: enable fails closed; a stored key is never presented as a delivering channel

cases.fault: swipe, CTA click and offline replay describe the same notification
cases.oracle: swipe_conversion is attributed once without double-counting click conversion

cases.fault: stale, forged or duplicated Janus proof races manual release
cases.oracle: only fresh trusted proof releases funds once

cases.fault: production remote mode lacks an executor or receives sandbox, duplicate or out-of-order ACK/proof
cases.oracle: production never falls back to sandbox and reaches applied only after trusted executor ACK and proof

cases.fault: every KPI attribution without href is clicked under allowed and denied target roles
cases.oracle: a real filtered deep link or explicit unavailability replaces prototype toast

cases.fault: B4, H1, I and F drill-down targets are opened with stale filters and insufficient authority
cases.oracle: each target preserves attribution context and fails explicitly when inaccessible

cases.fault: behavior events arrive duplicated, out of order and after an offline interval
cases.oracle: the server source deduplicates events and distinguishes true zero from unavailable ingestion

cases.fault: advisor batch binding fails at user N or times out after commit
cases.oracle: the whole batch rolls back or returns and rereads an authoritative per-user result under one command

cases.fault: M1 and M5 save different edits from the same profile version
cases.oracle: exactly one CAS mutation wins and unknown-result retry preserves its key and input

cases.fault: an M3-only actor loads transfer context and directly probes M1 data
cases.oracle: the dedicated minimum-data endpoint succeeds while out-of-leaf reads remain forbidden

cases.fault: ticket escalation commits after the browser loses the response
cases.oracle: the confirmation stays actionable and same-key retry resolves without duplicate escalation

cases.fault: conversation creation succeeds but the response carrying the server ID is lost
cases.oracle: retry returns the same server conversation and every dependent action uses its canonical ID

cases.fault: FAQ body and status change together while another editor saves
cases.oracle: both changes use one versioned command or neither commits; body loss cannot be reported as success

cases.fault: an M5-only actor receives 403 from sibling reads and the SSE endpoint
cases.oracle: no sibling data leaks, fatal authorization does not reconnect forever, and unavailable facts are not rendered as zero
